address: 27 Datong North Road, Sanchong District, New Taipei, Taiwan
bio: A favourite spot among locals for braised pork rice, this joint uses mostly fatty pork for its signature dish. The amber sauce has a glossy sheen and the diced pork melts in your mouth like sweets. A drizzle of house-made garlic chilli sauce adds an extra savoury, piquant dimension to the rice. Pair it with the shrimp soup, which boasts chunks of springy minced shrimp, fried garlic bits and a sweet, umami-laden broth.
